def npos(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((r0,c0))
    return sorted(out)
def barpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p':

r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':31}, 'UP'])

t = transitions[-1]
print('N :', npos(t.before_frame), '->', npos(t.after_frame))
print('bar:', barpos(t.before_frame), '->', barpos(t.after_frame))
